corrected_prompt:
Format: Handmade claymation stop-motion look: plasticine characters with visible thumbprints and slight tool marks, soft rounded forms, miniature handmade set pieces, warm practical lighting, shallow depth of field like a tabletop set, gentle stop-motion texture. Stop-motion clay puppet detail: tiny real craft materials on the clay, thread-wrapped hair, real fabric and felt, real stitching. Palette: warm ivory and marble, charcoal accents. A character reference sheet, square 1:1, on a plain soft warm-ivory paper backdrop with even studio light.

Reference images: none attached.

Subject: one clay puppet woman, Maya's friend, about 40, rounder build, deep brown skin, black curly hair in a high puff made of coiled thread, small tortoiseshell wire glasses, a teal-grey canvas jacket with two patch pockets over a cream top, dark jeans, white shoes; no cardigan. Left to right, the same woman three times, the head the same size in all three: (1) standing full body, front view, warm kind smile; (2) standing full body, three-quarter view, warm kind smile; (3) seated, shown as a head-and-shoulders bust that ends in a soft rounded clay cut at mid-chest with no chair, arms or hands shown, facing the camera as on a video call, curious, one brow raised as if asking a question.

Hands: in both full-body views both hands are inside her jacket pockets, so no fingers show; in the seated bust no hands show, because the bust ends above them.

Action: none, a still sheet.

Props: none besides her glasses and clothes.

Text: no text anywhere: no labels or names.

Setting: the plain warm-ivory backdrop only, soft contact shadows; no laptop, no screen border, no furniture.

Camera: straight-on at eye level, every view fully inside the frame with a 4% margin, square 1:1.

Continuity: this is the locked design of the friend for every later shot; she must read as clearly different from Maya (no olive cardigan, no bob).

Negatives: no olive cardigan, no bob haircut; no other characters; no visible fingers; no photoreal skin, no glossy CGI plastic; no logos. Everything in frame is real modeling clay, felt and fabric, photographed: visible fingerprints and tool marks, real cast shadows, soft studio lighting.
